dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides a municipal address point layer for Peachland, British Columbia. It supports location lookup, civic addressing, and address management by storing standardized address attributes alongside geographic point locations.

Layer

  • PCH Address Points: A point layer representing individual address locations for Peachland. The layer includes civic address components such as house number, street name, directional and street type elements, community and postal information, unit and building details, landmark and placement information, and location coordinates. It also includes date-based tracking fields that support address maintenance and updates.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Peachland area within the Regional District of Central Okanagan in British Columbia, Canada.

Use Cases

  • Address lookup and geocoding
  • Municipal addressing and civic records management
  • Emergency response and service routing
  • Postal and community reference
  • Supporting local GIS applications and web maps

Data Stewardship

The data is owned by District of Peachland and provided by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and is distributed under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License.
